A [[Writing/Legends|system]] of '''writing''' was used by the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moltok/Legends|Moltok]] to write their [[Language/Legends|language]], which was also called [[Ho'Din (language)|Ho'Din]]. The script's characters were derived from the shapes of [[Plant/Legends|plants]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Moltok.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ho'Din writing was mentioned in ''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]'', a [[2003]] sourcebook published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
